title: P2 Agent Runtime and UI Streaming
goal: Carry bounded provider deltas through the MV3 background Port and present an honest, accessible streaming Agent experience.

facts.text: Current Agent events and Port payloads carry complete messages rather than token deltas.
The UI replaces complete messages by ID and Stop currently disconnects the Port.
Conversation currently scrolls to the tail whenever children change.

constraints: Port messages carry minimal deltas with sessionId, baseRevision and sequence identity.
Partial assistant output is presentation state and never committed to session history after abort or protocol failure.
Status announcements do not read every token to assistive technology.
No hidden reasoning or thinking delta is rendered or logged.

requirements.text: Transport ordered bounded deltas and terminal events across the Agent Port.
Render incremental assistant text and observable tool execution states.
Implement Stop, failure draft recovery and safe partial-output history behavior.
Pause automatic scroll following when the user scrolls upward and preserve accessible interaction behavior.

acceptance_criteria.text: Duplicate, stale or out-of-order deliveries cannot mutate the active turn, and valid deltas apply once in order.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Port identity and sequence tests pass.

acceptance_criteria.text: Assistant text grows without replacing the whole transcript, and tool states distinguish queued, running, completed and failed.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Hook and component tests observe incremental text and tool state transitions.

acceptance_criteria.text: Stop aborts active provider/tool work; failures restore the prompt draft; aborted partial output is not added to bounded session history; ambiguous writes are not replayed.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Stop, disconnect, failure and write-retry regression tests pass.

acceptance_criteria.text: Scroll follows only while the user remains near the bottom, a resume affordance appears after upward scroll, and reduced-motion and live-region behavior remain accessible.
acceptance_criteria.proof: DOM and real ShadowRoot browser tests pass at wide and narrow widths.

design.summary: Keep provider deltas as transient turn state in the UI reducer and commit only the validated final message delivered by the runtime result.
boundaries: Background owns run and abort lifecycle.
Components own presentation, scroll and accessibility.
contracts: Every delta includes delivery identity and monotonically increasing sequence.
Stop has an explicit terminal presentation state.
Tool execution status is observable but tool arguments remain hidden.
Final validated messages replace transient output atomically.
compatibility: Keep OrganizeJob presentation separate from chat deltas.
rollout: Define Port events and reducer tests.
Implement UI states and scroll behavior.
rollback: Final result delivery remains available if delta rendering is disabled.
No durable data migration is required.
observability: Track terminal category and dropped stale/duplicate event counts.
Do not log message text or tool arguments.

steps.text: Define identity-bound delta and terminal Port messages with strict validation.
Add transient streaming state, final reconciliation, Stop and draft recovery to the Agent hook.
Implement incremental presentation, tool states, conditional scroll follow, accessibility and DESIGN.md updates.

verification.procedure: Run Agent messaging and turn-port tests for ordered, duplicate, stale, disconnect and terminal deliveries.
Run hook/reducer tests for incremental text, tool status, Stop, draft recovery and session history reconciliation.
Run the Agent in a real ShadowRoot and verify streaming, user scroll, resume follow, narrow layout, focus and reduced motion.
Run pnpm typecheck and pnpm test:logic.

risks.risk: Growing full messages create quadratic Port and render work.
risks.trigger: Each delta contains the complete partial response.
risks.mitigation: Send minimal deltas and batch UI updates.

risks.risk: Partial output contaminates future model history.
risks.trigger: Transient UI text is committed before validated terminal delivery.
risks.mitigation: Keep transient and committed messages in separate state paths.

risks.risk: Stop races with a write or final event.
risks.trigger: Disconnect is treated as proof that no write committed.
risks.mitigation: Use authoritative terminal/receipt ownership and prohibit replay when outcome is unknown.
